info.title: Local Node.js core permission/fs modeling excerpt from public sources

get.summary: Read resource path (models fs read path after permission.has fs.read gate)
Export/archive resource (models sensitive read sink after fs.read grant)

put.summary: Write resource path (models fs write path after permission.has fs.write gate)

delete.summary: Delete resource path (models destructive fs write-class action after fs.write grant)

post.summary: Symlink-style action (models fs.symlink requiring full fs read+write when permission model enabled)
